data.one_liner: Flutter package to handle dynamic TabBar and TabBarView easily.
data.what_it_does: Provides a DynamicTabBarWidget that automatically updates its tabs and tab bar views as items are added or removed from a list. It supports customization options like scrollable tabs, custom icons, leading/trailing widgets, and callbacks.
use_when: You need to add or remove tabs dynamically at runtime in your Flutter application.
You want a widget that automatically handles tab updates and tab controller state changes.
avoid_when: Your app uses a fixed set of tabs that never change during the application lifecycle.
strengths: Supports dynamic adding and removing of tabs easily.
Provides extensive customization for TabBar and TabBarView properties.
Includes features like web scroll behavior, custom back/next icons, and navigation position controls.
data.minimal_example:
DynamicTabBarWidget(
    dynamicTabs: tabs,
    isScrollable: isScrollable,
    onTabControllerUpdated: (controller) {},
    onTabChanged: (index) {},
    onAddTabMoveTo: MoveToTab.last,
)
